text:
Aisha: Who left a coffee ring on the meeting table and a very dramatic sticky note that says 'It wasn't me'? :coffee:
Ben: Not me. My coffee is an alibi. I was in the kitchen making a second alibi. :sweat_smile:
kudos-bot: :tada: Shoutout to Marta for bringing extra napkins yesterday! Reaction: :clap:  
Devon: Accepting nominations for best caffeine alibi. Prize: a sticker and moral victory.
Marta: My entry: 'I was interrogating the copy machine about toner.' :detective:
Sofia: Mine: 'The coffee mug and I have an open relationship.' :heartpulse:
Aisha: Also mini poll: sticker reward — sticker design A (coffee + moustache) or B (heroic napkin)? React :one: or :two:.
Ben: Also, can we ban ceramic mugs on the 2nd floor? They are stealth war criminals.
logistics-bot: FYI — lost-and-found updated: 3 ceramic mugs found on 2F. Claim at Facilities by EOD. Link: https://intranet/facilities/lost-and-found
Devon: New house rule: if your cup is asymmetric, you must label it with your initials. 
Marta: Alibi runner-up: 'I was debugging the thermostat, it saw me and screamed.' :thermometer:
Sofia: One-liner sprint: post your micro-alibis below. Keep it to one sentence.
Ben: 'My laptop stole my last sip.'
Aisha: 'I was on a fleeting quest for a pen that works.' :pen:
Devon: 'I solemnly swear I was whispering to the stapler.' :stapler:
Marta: 'Blame the intern I haven't met yet.' :innocent:
Sofia: 'I accidentally joined a coffee cult at 10:07.' :clock10:
kudos-bot: :sparkles: Marta earned a virtual sticker for napkins.
Aisha: Ok final: if no one claims the ring by 5pm we hold a ceremonial coffee ring burial in the planter. Vote :thumbsup: for burial, :thumbsdown: for leaving it as a mysterious artifact.
Ben: Burial. For the vibes.
Devon: Artifact. For lore.
Marta: Burial with eulogy. I'll write a haiku.
Sofia: Closing thread in 30m. Winner announced with sticker delivery and an embarrassing GIF.
